descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Consultanță pentru externalizare și delocalizare și Servicii IT și consultanță IT
ALTEN Romania is part of the ALTEN Group , Leader in IT and Engineering Consulting . We develop innovative and durable technical solutions that fulfill the needs of our local and international partners.
 About the role: 
 This role focuses on managing a hybrid Microsoft Enterprise and AWS infrastructure, investigating and resolving complex incidents, delivering infrastructure projects, and driving the continuous improvement of IT services.
 The selected candidate will work in a modern enterprise environment alongside Security, Network, Cloud, and Application teams, contributing to the administration, automation, and security of the infrastructure.
 A typical day might include the following: 
Administer Microsoft Windows Server infrastructure.
Manage Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, and DHCP services.
Administer VMware vSphere platforms (ESXi and vCenter).
Manage Windows servers hosted in AWS.
Investigate and resolve L2/L3 technical incidents.
Participate in Root Cause Analysis activities.
Contribute to infrastructure implementation and modernization projects.
Manage the Patch Management process for Windows Server and Windows Client environments.
Test, validate, and deploy updates across TEST, PRE-PROD, and Production environments.
Automate administrative tasks using PowerShell.
Create and maintain technical documentation.
Collaborate with Security teams to remediate vulnerabilities.
Participate in Incident Management, Change Management, and Problem Management processes.
Contribute to the standardization and continuous improvement of the IT infrastructure.
 To ensure success in this role, you need the following experience and skills: 
Minimum 4-5 years of experience administering Enterprise Windows infrastructures.
Strong hands-on experience with Windows Server.
Practical experience with Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, and DHCP.
Experience administering VMware vSphere platforms (ESXi and vCenter).
Good PowerShell skills for administration and automation.
Experience with Patch Management solutions (WSUS, SCCM, Intune, Tanium, or equivalent).
Experience with ServiceNow or another ITSM platform.
Knowledge of ITIL processes.
Understanding of TCP/IP networking and firewall technologies (Palo Alto, Fortinet, Check Point, Cisco ASA, or equivalent).
Basic knowledge of Microsoft Windows infrastructure administration in AWS, including EC2, VPC, Security Groups, IAM, and Active Directory integration.
Experience troubleshooting Windows Server environments and investigating complex incidents.
English proficiency at B2 level or higher.
 Nice to have skills: 
Microsoft Azure.
Microsoft Entra ID.
Microsoft Defender.
PKI / Certificate Services.
DFS, IIS, and Failover Clustering.
LAPS and BitLocker.
CrowdStrike.
Terraform or Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
Advanced automation skills.
 Only eligible candidates will be contacted in a maximum of 2 weeks. Any information you provide is confidential.
